ID: STR-002 | Type: Strategy | Theme: Safety before release | Statement: Prevent unsafe product configurations from release | Status: Active

Engineering Change ECR-001. Title: Increase battery capacity. Primary component: BAT-001. Change description: 40 Ah -> 50 Ah. Risk: High. Status: Open.
Engineering Change ECR-002. Title: Increase battery energy density. Primary component: BAT-001. Change description: Baseline -> higher energy density cell. Risk: Medium. Status: Closed.
